title: PostgreSQL 16: lowering wal_level with logical slots present stops the server
symptom: FATAL: logical replication slot "<slot>" exists, but wal_level < logical. The container exits on restart.
cause: PostgreSQL's startup check. PostgreSQL 16 doesn't invalidate the slots.
effect: The server doesn't start until the slots are dropped or wal_level is raised again.
fix: Drop the logical slots first, then lower wal_level. On PostgreSQL 16 check a lost slot with wal_status; invalidation_reason exists from PostgreSQL 17.
